0.000e+00 the projection factor is cos(theta) and theta = 0 here, so omitting it changes nothing. A control evaluated only at normal incidence therefore cannot prove projection handling, however green it comes out.

0.000e+00 dr(x, y) is measured from the ray's own launch point, so for a single ray at the origin it is identically zero. That geometry cannot prove the ramp, and the CHE-41 off-axis defect is the same blindness one level up.

before rescaling 9.990e-01, after rescaling by the recovered 1024.000000 it is 0.000e+00, and NCC reads 1.000000000. under uniform sampling p is a constant, so omitting 1/p multiplies the field by that constant and nothing else. After rescaling, the two agree to round-off -- so an NCC or any scale-invariant metric would certify the biased estimator, and the importance-weight control has to be run under MAGNITUDE sampling to mean anything.

bitwise reproducibility at a fixed seed is asserted by tests/test_wave_to_ray.py::test_same_seed_gives_bitwise_identical_rays and is labelled REPRODUCIBILITY. It is not evidence of accuracy and is deliberately not one of the four kinds above.

expected.why: four kinds of evidence in a mandated order: exactness limit first, because an estimator that is wrong in the enumeration limit has a transform defect and tuning N would be beside the point; then unbiasedness against the MEASURED standard error; then a fitted exponent over at least six sample counts; then variance by sampling density, reported as a size rather than a pass.

convergence.note: six sample counts, three seeds each, on the magnitude-sampled estimator. The expected -0.5 is the Monte Carlo rate and it is a prediction rather than a fit target; a different exponent would be a finding about the estimator rather than about the fit.

blind_to: bias in the kernel, which the enumeration shares. Evidence kind 1 of four, and it does not imply the other three

measured.note: every one of 1024 propagating modes enumerated, so there is no sampling error at all. FIRST, because an estimator that is wrong here has a transform defect and tuning N would be beside the point.

physics_accuracy.tolerance_basis: an exactness limit admits float64 round-off only; the measured wave-rays-wave round trip at the enumeration limit is 1.32e-15

blind_to: a bias smaller than the ensemble can resolve, which shrinks only as sqrt(seeds)

measured.note:
|mean bias| / measured standard error on the SIGNED overlap functional <W, U_hat> against a fixed independent probe vector, worst of its real and imaginary parts (real). The tolerance IS the measured standard error, so the gate is a property of the run rather than a chosen field-space constant.

Signed and linear on purpose. Measuring the mean of a NORM instead -- which the first version of this driver did -- tests a quantity that is positive by construction, so its mean over standard error grows without bound as the ensemble converges and read 13.5 sigma for an estimator that is in fact unbiased.

physics_accuracy.tolerance_basis: three standard errors of the ensemble mean. A bias inside 3 sigma is not distinguishable from zero by this many seeds, and a bias outside it is not chance. Stated in sigma rather than in field units because the resolvable bias depends on the ensemble size

blind_to: curvature outside the fitted range. An exponent measured over three decades says nothing about the fourth

measured.note: fitted over six sample counts; the expected rate is -0.5

blind_to: the spatial distribution of the variance

measured.note: uniform/magnitude residual ratio on a CONCENTRATED spectrum, 6.2799x, with the multilobed spectrum's 1.1292x as the error bar. The SIZE of the advantage is the reported property: magnitude-proportional sampling exploits spectral concentration and is merely comparable to uniform without it.

blind_to: where in the spectrum it was discarded from

measured.note: the discarded fraction, REPORTED rather than absorbed. Propagated plus discarded equals the input power by construction of the cut, and the invariant below asserts it.

ensemble_mean.note: relative L2 over 8 seeds. Reported as the ensemble's central value; the UNBIASEDNESS gate is on the signed overlap functional below, not on this norm.
